title: FRED FX Rates and Real Yields
description: Currency pairs and real-yield / breakeven signals for the Global Macro Risk Brief. Tracks EUR/JPY/CNY/MXN/BRL/GBP/CAD/AUD/INR/CHF against USD via FRED daily series, plus US 10Y TIPS real yield and 10Y breakeven inflation. Each row reports latest spot, 30-day change (pct), 90-day change (pct), and a regime flag: FX pairs flagged USD_STRENGTH / USD_WEAKNESS / STABLE; real yields flagged RISING (tight financial conditions - defensive) / FALLING (easing conditions - risk-on); breakeven flagged INFLATION_RISING / ANCHORED / INFLATION_FALLING. Investment thesis maps to ETF tickers (FXE/FXY/CYB/FXM/BZF/FXB/FXC/FXA/FXF; TIP for real yields; RINF for breakeven). Uses existing FRED_API_KEY.
